verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence documents a sprint feature. Community reports do show teams using Notion as a project and issue tracker (comm-6, comm-11) and placing it between strict JIRA-style PM tools and wikis (comm-15), and a GitHub sync integration exists (docs-17). Users also say they 'quickly reach limits' when using it this way (comm-6), so agile sprint management looks possible only as a build-it-yourself setup on generic databases. Missing for 10: documented sprint/cycle features (backlog, sprint planning, velocity/burndown), first-party agile templates or docs, and hands-on evidence of sprint workflows working well.
